title: coelas procumbens
intro: Coelas procumbens, commonly known as American Burnweed, is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Coelas procumbens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Coelas procumbens include wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable plant for natural remedies.
